title: Predication cells are mark-supported and generable from articulations without recovering provenance
headline: Obsmetrologia.PredicationCell.syntheticSource_orientedCell

requirements.statement: Subject, predicate and object marks of every generated oriented cell occur in the generating articulating mark provenance.
Every PredicationCell has a synthetic articulating built only from the cell marks whose orientedCell is exactly that cell.
Articulating.orientedCell is not injective: distinct articulated histories can have the same predication cell.
The synthetic source proves generability only; it is not a left inverse recovering historical articulation provenance.

prohibitions.statement: Never describe syntheticSource as recovery or reconstruction of the original articulated history.
The synthetic source may duplicate cell marks but may not invent a new primitive mark.

blueprint.section: Predication is generated from articulated marks
blueprint.label: thm:predication-mark-provenance
blueprint.title: Predication cells descend from articulated marks, but cells do not recover histories
blueprint.statement: Every coordinate mark of an oriented predication cell is supported by the generating articulating. Every cell has a synthetic articulated source, but orientedCell is non-injective, so generability does not imply historical provenance recovery.
